contents.DefaultText: Hello everyone! Hope you're all doing well. Here's the patch notes for today. Version EA_0.07: - Fixed a bug that would get the game stuck when travelling to an area where a fox carcass had rotted. - Fixed a bug where the "confirm" popup for certain actions would appear too high on the screen. - Fixed a bug where the "Eat All" action would appear on bowls that only contained a liquid (like tea for instance). - Satiation overhaul: After having a big meal it takes significantly longer for the player to drop all the way down to 0 satiation. - Washing yourself in a River or with a Water Container no longer makes your clothes Wet. - Oven can now be Extinguished just like Campfire can. - Cellar passive effect for food preservation is not working as intended and is temporarily disabled. - Quite a few perk combinations such as Social/Loner are now mutually exclusive. - Added fat chunk to the food filter. - Extended the duration of dried meat. That's all for now. See you tomorrow!
contents.Text: 大家好！ 希望你们都好。 这是今天的更新日志。 版本 EA_0.07： - 修复了在前往狐狸尸体腐烂区域时游戏会卡住的bug - 修复了某些操作的“确认”弹出窗口在屏幕上显示过高的错误。 - 修复了“吃掉所有”操作会出现在只包含液体（例如茶）的碗上的错误。 - 饱食度大修：吃完一顿大餐后，玩家需要更长的时间才会完全降到 0 饱食度。 - 在河里或用含水容器清洗自己不再会弄湿衣服。 - 烤箱现在可以像篝火一样熄灭。 - 地窖的食品保鲜被动效果未按预期工作，暂时禁用。 - 部分特质（例如社交分子/独来独往）现在互斥。 - 在食物过滤器中添加了脂肪块。 - 延长了干肉的保质期。 目前就这些。 明天见！
